name: mise action
description: Actions for working with mise runtime manager

version.description: The version of mise to use. If not specified, will use the latest release.

sha256.description: The SHA256 checksum of the mise binary to verify the download.

mise_dir.description:
The directory that mise will be installed to, defaults to $HOME/.local/share/mise
Or $XDG_DATA_HOME/mise if $XDG_DATA_HOME is set.
Or $MISE_DATA_DIR if $MISE_DA

tool_versions.description: If present, this value will be written to the .tool-versions file

mise_toml.description: If present, this value will be written to the mise.toml file

install.description: if false, will not run `mise install`

install_args.description: Arguments to pass to `mise install` such as "bun" to only install bun

cache.description: if false, action will not read or write to cache

cache_save.description: if false, action will not write to cache

cache_key_prefix.description: The prefix key to use for the cache, change this to invalidate the cache

cache_key.description:
Override the complete cache key (ignores all other cache key options).
Supports template variables: {{version}}, {{cache_key_prefix}}, {{platform}}, {{file_hash

experimental.description: if true, will use experimental features

log_level.description: The log level to use for the action

working_directory.description: The directory that mise runs in

reshim.description: if true, will run `mise reshim --all` after setting up mise

add_shims_to_path.description: if false, will not add mise shims directory to PATH

github_token.description:
GitHub token for API authentication to avoid rate limits when installing GitHub-hosted tools.
Defaults to the automatic GitHub token.

fetch_from_github.description: If true (default), fetch the mise binary from GitHub. If false and using the latest version, fetch from mise.jdx.dev instead.

env.description: Automatically load mise env vars into GITHUB_ENV. Note that PATH modifications are not part of this.
